FN-EG41C9C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 74
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/27/2024
Senate Bill 74 as introduced would require the Governor to appoint the State Health Officer,
and the State Personnel Board to establish the State Health Officer's salary, which could increase
or decrease the obligations of the Department of Public Health by an undetermined amount
dependent upon the difference in the salary amount currently set by the State Committee of
Public Health and the amount that would be set by the Personnel Board.
